description: Returns the WoW: Forever talent trees of one class from the game files (found in game files, unconfirmed, with the build): every node with its talents, ranks, grid position, prerequisites and row gate, plus the levels talent points arrive at. Node ids are the ids a share code names. Use it to read or explain a class's trees; use talent_plan to decode a share code against them, and class_races for which races can be the class. Narrow to one tree by name; without it the answer holds every node of every tree. With builds, the answer also lists the Everloot team's published starter builds for the class, each labelled as the team's and not observed, with its share code and page. The answer links the calculator.

builds.description: Also list the Everloot team's starter builds for the class, with share codes. They are the team's, not observed.

tree.description: One tree by name, such as Arcane. Without it, every tree.

name: talent_tree

build.description: The game build the trees were read from.

anyOf.description: If listed, at least one of these must be at full rank too.

pointsInTree.description: Points needed in this tree on rows above.

pointsTotal.description: Points needed in the build, any tree.

scope.description: Where the files say the gate counts; unconfirmed is read as the tree.

id.description: The client's trait node id, the id a share code names.

kind.description: A tiered node buys its entries in order; a choice node picks one.

prereqs.description: Node ids that must all be at full rank first.

maxRanks.description: Ranks this entry takes, for a tiered node.

pointLevels.description: The level each point arrives at.

total.description: Talent points at the max level.

specId.description: The client's spec id, or 0 when unknown.

starterBuilds.description: With builds: the team's published starter builds for the class (and tree), by name. Empty when none is published.

build.description: The game build the code was made on.

label.const: Everloot team starter build, not observed

tree.description: The tree the build leans on.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.

title: Talent trees for one class
